review_candidates.title: Customer Service Operation Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: Build, Scale & Operate Leading DTC Brands alongside A-Players Maneuver Marketing Our Vision, Mission & Success are fuelled by our commitment to be a driving force of positive change to the health of everyday consumers, providing conscious, high-quality & innovative supplement products. In just 5 years, we kicked off our own DTC Health & Wellness brand from scratch and scaled it to USD$100M+ in annual sales, serving more than 3,000,000 customers worldwide with an average of 4,000 daily orders across 9 SKUs. These results caught the attention of The Financial Times, as they ranked us among APACs top High-Growth Companies. We have also been awarded 2nd place on the E50 Awards, jointly organised by The Business Times and KPMG in Singapore. This is just the beginning of our journey, and you could be part of the next stage of our growth! Your Next Role The Customer Service Operation Support (CSOS) team handles specialist customer cases and operational activities beyond frontline Customer Service scope, enabling frontline agents to focus on established service processes. The CSOS Agent investigates and progresses assigned cases, applies approved procedures, maintains accurate records and coordinates follow-up through resolution or an accepted handover. The role also supports temporary customer-facing initiatives and develops proficiency across core workflows to provide team coverage. Agents are accountable for accurate execution and follow-through within delegated authority. The CSOS Team Lead owns CSOS processes, controls, operational knowledge and overall team performance. What You’ll Do Chargebacks and Payment Disputes Investigate assigned disputes, gather relevant evidence and prepare accurate submissions using approved tools and workflows. Complete required quality checks, meet submission deadlines and maintain supporting records. Monitor assigned disputes and promptly flag evidence gaps, system issues or deadlines at risk. Specialist Case Handling Investigate and process assigned reshipments, delivery issues, complex escalations, refund and payment exceptions, and other approved CSOS case types. Validate and route eligible account and data requests through approved procedures, with system-level execution performed by Tech. Apply approved resolutions within delegated authority, communicate outcomes professionally and escalate cases requiring additional decisions or specialist review. Case Management and Operational Continuity Manage assigned queues and priorities, maintain accurate case records and follow up on outstanding actions through completion or an accepted handover. Coordinate routine support with relevant teams and flag unresolved dependencies, capacity constraints or other blockers promptly. Develop proficiency across core workflows and provide backup coverage as assigned. Quality and Operational Controls Follow current SOPs, approval requirements and financial and data-handling controls. Complete required checks on casework and AI-assisted outputs, using approved tools and authorized system access. Participate in QA reviews and coaching, correct errors and promptly report suspected control failures. Knowledge and Continuous Improvement Identify unclear guidance, recurring case issues and opportunities to improve accuracy or reduce unnecessary work. Contribute practical feedback and documentation updates under the CSOS Team Lead’s direction. Support testing of new processes, tools and automation, and adapt to changes in CSOS workflows. Temporary Customer-Facing Initiatives Support assigned activities such as outbound campaign calls, beta-tester communications and other temporary customer-facing initiatives. Follow agreed objectives and handling guidance, record outcomes and surface relevant customer feedback or operational issues. Coordinate priorities with the CSOS Team Lead and support handover when activities move into an established process. Decision Authority and Escalation The agent may resolve assigned cases and perform approved actions within documented procedures and delegated financial and approval limits. Routine cross-functional coordination forms part of this responsibility. Escalate unclear guidance, policy exceptions, decisions beyond authority, suspected fraud, adverse events or medical claims, data or control concerns, and blockers that threaten timely completion. Administrative support for sensitive cases should follow approved guidance. Changes to CSOS procedures and controls require the process owner’s approval. Required Capabilities Strong attention to detail, investigative skills and follow-through. Sound judgement within approved guidance and awareness of when to escalate. Ability to prioritize deadlines, maintain accurate records and work across multiple systems. Clear written and verbal English, including confidence with occasional outbound calls. Reliable remote working practices and care when handling customer information and financial actions. Willingness to learn across workflows, accept coaching and adapt to new tools and responsibilities. Desirable Experience Customer Service, e-commerce operations or specialist case handling. Chargebacks, payment disputes, reshipments or outbound customer contact. Zendesk, Shopify or comparable customer-service, payment and fulfilment systems. AI-assisted workflows, process testing, spreadsheets and collaboration tools. How You’ll Succeed Success is demonstrated through accurate work, timely case progression, clear documentation, appropriate escalation, reliable coverage and consistent application of feedback. Specific targets are set separately according to assigned responsibilities.

Reporting to the GP&S Assistant Director for Intelligence, this role will provide leadership and strategic direction to the regional intelligence team, oversee the development of timely and actionable intelligence assessments, and partner with stakeholders across the organization to support informed security decision-making. The successful candidate will bring strong people leadership, intelligence analysis expertise, sound judgment and the ability to translate complex geopolitical and security developments into clear, relevant insights for stakeholders at different levels of the organization. Key Responsibilities Lead and provide strategic direction to a team of EMEA-based intelligence analysts responsible for monitoring and assessing geopolitical, security and operational developments across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Coach, mentor and develop team members while supporting consistent analytical quality, collaboration and effective delivery. Identify, research and assess geopolitical developments, emerging threats and security risks using a broad range of relevant information and intelligence sources. Provide regional expertise on developments across Europe, the Middle East and Africa and assess their potential implications for Accenture’s people and business operations. Author, review and edit intelligence assessments addressing issues ranging from tactical security threats to broader strategic geopolitical developments. Apply established intelligence analysis methodologies and tradecraft to support high-quality, objective and actionable assessments. Translate complex intelligence and geopolitical developments into concise insights that support stakeholder awareness and decision-making. Build effective relationships with security stakeholders and collaborate across functions including Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Communications and relevant Market Units. Engage with GP&S and business stakeholders to understand intelligence requirements and ensure analysis remains relevant to evolving business and security priorities. Contribute to the continued development of the regional intelligence capability, including analytical standards, ways of working and knowledge sharing. Basic Qualifications Minimum of 10 years of professional experience in all-source intelligence analysis within government, military, law enforcement, corporate security or the private sector. Minimum of 2 years of experience leading or supervising teams in a professional environment. Demonstrated experience analyzing geopolitical, security or intelligence developments and assessing their potential impact on organizations or operations. Strong analytical and critical-thinking capabilities, with the ability to evaluate complex information and develop clear, well-supported assessments. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience communicating complex information to a range of stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a collaborative, fast-paced and geographically dispersed environment. Ability to occasionally work outside regular business hours and on weekends based on operational requirements. Ability to work business hours aligned with the Eastern Time Zone, as required by the role. Preferred Qualifications Graduate degree in International Relations, Security Studies, Intelligence, Political Science or a related field. Formal training in intelligence analysis, structured analytical techniques or intelligence tradecraft. Demonstrated knowledge of the geopolitical and security environment across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. Experience producing and reviewing strategic and tactical intelligence assessments for senior stakeholders. Experience leading, coaching and developing intelligence or security professionals. Experience collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders in a multinational or complex global organization. Proficiency with open-source intelligence research and monitoring platforms. Proficiency with Microsoft 365 applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Microsoft Forms.

review_candidates.title: Global Payroll Operations Supervisor
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Global Payroll Operations Supervisor based in Brazil. This is a leadership role responsible for scaling payroll operations and customer implementations across Brazil. You will oversee end-to-end payroll execution while maintaining compliance, accuracy, service quality, and operational efficiency. The position combines people leadership with hands-on expertise in Brazilian payroll systems, regulations, and processes. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, customers, and external stakeholders to support market expansion. A key focus will be building scalable processes, reducing manual errors, and introducing automation into payroll operations. You will lead and develop a high-performing team while monitoring KPIs, SLAs, quality, and delivery timelines. The role offers significant exposure to product development, customer experience, and the evolution of global payroll capabilities. Accountabilities Lead end-to-end payroll operations in Brazil, ensuring accurate, compliant, and on-time payroll delivery. Drive payroll implementations for new customers, including data migration, parallel runs, configuration, validation, and go-live support. Configure, troubleshoot, and validate Brazilian payroll processes using local payroll software such as Senior alongside the native payroll platform. Lead and develop a team of payroll operations specialists, including hiring, onboarding, training, performance management, and professional development. Establish and monitor team KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, deadlines, and operational performance. Develop scalable, repeatable processes and SOPs that reduce manual errors and make operations easier to learn, expand, and measure. Manage customer and employee inquiries through operational cases, ensuring timely resolution and consistent service standards. Support issue resolution involving government agencies and authorities, including eSocial, INSS, Receita Federal, FGTS, and Caixa, as well as external partners and customers. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to ensure payroll technology addresses Brazilian statutory and tax requirements, including INSS, FGTS, eSocial, 13th salary, férias, and rescisão. Contribute to new product and customer launches by translating operational requirements into implementation plans, resources, and processes. Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvements to increase efficiency and scalability. Monitor operational progress and communicate risks, requirements, and performance insights to relevant stakeholders. Requirements 7+ years of professional experience in Brazilian payroll processing or payroll operations. 3+ years of experience managing payroll operations professionals, including experience leading teams of 6 or more people. Strong knowledge of end-to-end Brazilian payroll procedures and legislation, including INSS, FGTS, eSocial, IRRF, 13th salary, férias, and rescisão/termination calculations. Hands-on experience with Brazilian payroll software such as Senior, including configuration, troubleshooting, and payroll-output validation. Proven experience leading customer payroll implementations in Brazil, including data migration, parallel payroll runs, and go-live activities. Experience with both in-house payroll processing and payroll operations delivered through partners or BPO providers.
